title: rewrite a merged change as a reviewer sentence
provenance: The squash-commit description of a real merged change, omnibase_core 2a5ac713abf15c465fe64c07ef94125b3721b4ac.
prompt:
Rewrite this merged change's description as a one-sentence summary a reviewer can read in five seconds. Keep the ticket identifier OMN-16677 and the name `run_harness_workflow` exactly as written. Add nothing the description does not state. At most 35 words.

CHANGE (omnibase_core#1603):
feat(OMN-16677): expose the tier-0 local runtime harness as `onex run`

The infra-free local runtime harness (OMN-13420) is the documented first-run
experience, but was reachable only as:

    ./.venv/bin/python -m omnibase_core.runtime.harness.harness_cli delegation ...

That is not a product surface — it leaks an internal module path, assumes the
venv layout, and is invisible to `onex --help`. `[project.scripts] onex` already
pointed at the click group; the harness was simply never registered on it.

Adds `onex run <delegation|sea>` with the same options the harness CLI already
accepted. The argparse core is refactored into one shared callable,
`run_harness_workflow`, which both the new click command and the existing
`python -m` shim call. There is no second copy of the logic and no behavior
change: the `python -m` path keeps working exactly as before.

`run-node` (remote Kafka dispatch) is untouched; both commands now carry one
help line naming which runtime they target, so they are not confusable.

Refs: OMN-16677

Respond with the answer only. Do not show your reasoning, do not narrate your steps, and do not preface the answer with anything.
